title: Fast-path validate→apply→log→toast block duplicated 4x in qos_panel.odin (3x byte-identical for the same command kind)
detail: The same block is copied byte-identically at app/qos_panel.odin:228-237 and :251-260 (both Cmd_Set_Emphasis) and shaped-same at :155-164 (Cmd_Set_Lane); main.odin holds four more sites (:645, :705, :881, :899). The E10 logging convention is single-sourced nowhere.
recommended_fix: Extract one helper, e.g. app_emit_cmd(app: ^App, cmd: pp.Command) -> bool wrapping validate→apply→append(action_log)→reject-toast; route the four qos_panel emit sites (and later main.odin's) through it.
